purpose: Freeze full-population integrity validation and the observed cardinality invariant for the shared Hero <-> Exclusive Equipment canonical relation before bidirectional indexes are generated.

validationArtifact.publicationGate: B-5 may generate byHero/byEquipment indexes only from the exact relation-set blob SHA that B-4 validates as PASS.

scope: Canonical Hero population is exactly 267 unique heroId values.
Exclusive Equipment population is exactly 167 unique equipmentId values selected only by acquisitionClass=exclusive-equipment.
The relation equipmentId set exactly equals the frozen 167 exclusive-equipment ID set.
No launch, legacy-additional, current-additional, soul-special, or unresolved-no-path equipment appears in the relation.
identity: Every edge.heroId exists in the canonical Hero master.
Every edge.equipmentId exists in the frozen exclusive-equipment population.
No duplicate canonical (heroId, equipmentId) pair exists.
provenance: Every edge contains authoritative EQUIPMENT_SKILL_HERO provenance.
Authoritative provenance table is ConfigDataEquipmentInfo, recordId equals edge.equipmentId, field is SkillHero, and value equals edge.heroId.
No heuristic source may repair, create, or override an ownership edge.
coverage: Every frozen exclusive equipment ID appears exactly once.
Unmapped exclusive equipment count is zero.
cardinality: Every exclusive equipment has exactly one canonical owner Hero.
Every canonical Hero owns zero or one current exclusive equipment in this relation snapshot.
Exactly 167 Heroes have one exclusive equipment and 100 Heroes have zero.
No Hero has two or more current exclusive equipment edges.
No exclusive Equipment has two or more owner Hero edges.
b3Parity: B-3 canonicalEdgeCount, mappedExclusiveEquipmentCount, uniqueOwnerHeroCount and error counters agree with direct B-4 recomputation.

cardinalityInvariant.meaning: The current canonical relation is one-to-one between the 167 released exclusive Equipment records and a 167-Hero owner subset; it is not a claim that all 267 Heroes already have released exclusive Equipment.
cardinalityInvariant.changePolicy: If a future source snapshot explicitly introduces shared ownership or more than one current exclusive Equipment for a Hero, treat the old invariant as REVIEW and update the Stage B contract/version from explicit source evidence. Never silently collapse, discard, or heuristically select one edge to preserve this invariant.

severityPolicy.PASS: All hard validation groups pass with zero unresolved errors.
severityPolicy.FAIL: A current-source structural or semantic invariant is broken; B-5 must not consume the relation.
severityPolicy.REVIEW: Explicit source evolution may have changed a frozen population/cardinality assumption and requires contract/version review before acceptance.

downstreamRule: B-5 derives both indexes only from the B-4 validated canonical relation set. Neither index may add, delete, repair, or reinterpret ownership.
completion: B-4 is complete when the full 167-edge relation passes exact scope, identity, schema, provenance, coverage, and cardinality checks; the equipment->Hero exactly-one and Hero->Equipment zero-or-one cardinality is frozen; and the validation result pins the exact relation-set blob SHA for B-5.
